utterances.text: I don't know when exactly that was. Maybe in April. I don't know when it began exactly.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: You are saying something about the month of April.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: But you heard about nothing before April?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, there is a document I would like to show this witness, a document, but I would not like to be interrupted by the adjournment in doing so, because we have less than five minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So for the last five minutes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let us deal with this document. Can we see in e-court 2D 00281. Or if that's problem, to speed matters up, perhaps we can place it on the ELMO. The witness does not have the document. It's not one of his.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Can you see that, Witness?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Now, let's take a look at it to the. It says "Bregava Brigade." The date is the 26th of January, 1993. So as we have said, on the basis of your knowledge during that time there were no conflicts with the HVO. Isn't that right? Now, let's show the witness the last page. May we zoom in on page 3 for the witness to be able to see who signed the document, please. You have it in front of you, Witness. You can turn to page 3 or you can take a look on your screen. On the last page we have a signature there, and it is the commander Mr. Bajro Pizovic. You have to give me an answer for the transcript, an audible answer. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: The usher has the document ready for you. You can take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I can see it.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Can you see that it was sent to the 4th corps? And that's on the left of the document.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: May we go to page 1 on e-court, please. I'll read it out, and you have the document. It says here, and this is an answer to some document dated the 22nd of January, and it says: "The beginning of organisation for setting up resistance and fighting the aggressor in the Stolac municipality, date before April 1992." Now, when the aggressor that is mentioned it is the Serbs that are plenty; is that right? Before April 1992 the aggressor was the Serbs; is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: It goes on to say, "As the protagonists individuals appear, new members of the SDA party, through rallying their members, the formation of units based on the territorial principle, and on the basis of coming up as volunteers. The units were mobile. They were armed with infantry weapons and a smaller quantity of arms for anti-tank combat." Now, when you joined the unit in August 1992, what was your impression? How was the unit armed, and did you have any weapons yourself?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I really don't know. I wasn't in the command staff, so how could I know what the brigade had? I myself was not armed. I did not have any weapons. I was a driver. I had no arms myself, and I say that with full responsibility. As to the rest, what the brigade had, I really can't say. I really don't know kind of weapons the brigade had. I wasn't on the command staff. I had no idea of things like that. I did my own job.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: May we go on to page 2. And I'd like to mention that I'm looking at point 3 on page 1. And in Croatian, for the witness, where it says ,"Basic activities, measures which were implemented during that period," and that is during the fighting against the Serbs. And now the third bullet point which says as follows: "The weapons were obtained by seizing weapons from the former JNA and then later on from HVO units." Did you have any knowledge that in January, while there were still no conflicts with the HVO, someone from your brigades seized weapons from HVO units?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Please believe me, and I'd like to repeat this. I've been repeating it God knows how many times, I really don't know about any of this. How do you mean from the HVO? From the Serb army, how these weapons were seized? I really don't know. It's not that I'm defending myself, but I really don't know. I have no knowledge of that.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Sir, you don't need to defend yourself. You were just saying that this was your commander and that during this material period you were a member of the unit, so I was just checking out whether you might know anything about this. It's not my intention to do anything other than that. And let's just look at point 6 on that second page, and that will complete my questioning based on this document. We're dealing with January, and we saw the document was dated January. And now it goes on to say: "Proposals to improve the efficiency of combat operations."

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I can see that.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: Several proposals are mentioned, but nowhere does it say procurement of weapons, which would lead one to conclude that weapons were not a problem for this brigade. You can read it for yourself, but I just wanted to point out that particular point. "The forming and training and equipment of units for sabotage activity." Is that right? Is that what it says in the document?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, that's what it says.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. I have no further questions based on this document, but I'd like to continue with the court's permission tomorrow and use up my 10 minutes tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. We'll resume tomorrow. You have 10 minutes left. We adjourn until tomorrow at 2.15. Between now and then, Witness, you're not to see any members of the Prosecution or discuss with anybody any of what -- anything of what has passed this afternoon in the courtroom. Thank you.
